name: query_gnomad
description: Get population allele frequencies and variant statistics from gnomAD for a variant
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_gnomad; result = query_gnomad('rs113488022')

parameters.variant_id: str — rs ID or chr-pos-ref-alt format (e.g. '1-55516888-G-GA')

returns: dict with keys: variant_id, allele_freq, population_frequencies (dict by ancestry), n_homozygotes, source
